On Treasure Island, near Liberty Bay, you can use {item:Treasure Map (Pirate)|Pirate Treasure Maps} to dig up hidden holes that lead to underground caves full of undead and crabs. There is no reward or known quest: it is an exploration of the island's caves.
Captain Waverider, southeast of Liberty Bay
250 gp for travel (200 gp to go to Treasure Island and 50 gp to return)
one per hole; the Treasure Map sold on the island does NOT work
No known reward: just access to the island's underground caves
When you dig one of the spots on the island with a {item:Treasure Map (Pirate)|Pirate Treasure Map} in your backpack.
It is not permanent: each hole you open uses up one Pirate Treasure Map.
Bring several Pirate Treasure Maps if you want to open more than one hole: each hole uses one.
When you go down you face all the enemies at once. Get ready before entering.
If you are not in **Liberty Bay** yet, take a boat there (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais): talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}.
Go to the small hut **south-east of Liberty Bay** and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}. Say {key:hi} and ask to go to {key:treasure island} (200 gp); confirm with {key:yes}.

You disembark at the dock of {wiki:Treasure Island}, a small island south-west of Liberty Bay. {npc:Captain Waverider} is also on this dock: he is how you get back. Watch out for the holes and rubble scattered around the island.
There are specific spots on the island where you can dig with the {item:Shovel} to open hidden holes that lead underground. Use the map to find them.
The spots on Treasure Island where you can dig
Digging with a Pirate Treasure Map

With a {item:Treasure Map (Pirate)|Pirate Treasure Map} in your backpack, dig at one of those spots. Each hole you open uses up **one** Pirate Treasure Map. Without a map, you get the message "Sorry, not possible.".
The holes are trapped and may spawn {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} at first. Keep digging until the hole opens.

Leads to an open circular room full of enemies. {item:Great Fireball Rune|GFB} is recommended. One floor further down there are more enemies, what looks like a graveyard and a sign condemning a horrible sailor.
You face all the enemies at once when you go down.
Leads to {creature:Crab|Crabs} and {creature:Blood Crab|Blood Crabs}. From here you can see, but not reach, 2 treasure chests on floor -2.

All the other holes lead to a big, interconnected undead cave ({creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Pirate Skeleton|Pirate Skeletons}, {creature:Pirate Ghost|Pirate Ghosts}).
Use the {item:Rope} to get out of the holes and pay 50 gp to return from Treasure Island.
Go back to the hole you came down through and use the {item:Rope} to climb up to the island's surface.

Go to the island's dock and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes} (50 gp). You return to the hut southeast of Liberty Bay. Keep the 50 gp for the trip back before you spend any money on the island.
There is no reward or known quest on Treasure Island: the chests visible in the top-right hole are not reachable.
